body:
(a) Both in the foreground via the Bash tool: selftest with a 200 s tool timeout, recv with a 590 s timeout (just above the 540 s default block). No background jobs.
(b) No permission prompt for the channel commands. The only gate was my session's change_directory call to E:\proj\agent_comms, granted immediately; I saw no other prompt.
(c) A "No folder" scratch workspace, not the project. I moved to E:\proj\agent_comms with change_directory before reading anything.
(d) Add: "Your tool's time limit must exceed --block-seconds, or pass a smaller --block-seconds yourself" as an explicit command example, not just a warning.
